[Ascension Creature Abilities] Reduced the duration of all Poisons and Diseases by 50%.
[Ascension Creature Abilities] Creatures can now cast Cleaves without their target standing directly in front of them.

[Ascension Creature Abilities] Removed cost requirements for a number of abilities.

Fixed a bug where pets sometimes would not attack after being feared.

Fixed a bug where Frugal Disposition used to take the full overheal amount instead of half, as tooltip says.

Hand of Fate prices have been reduced. Your first Hand of Fate quest now costs 250 down from 500 Marks of Ascension. The scaling cost for Hand of Fates has been drastically reduced. Hand of Fate cost now goes up by 25 Marks of Ascension per quest, down from 50 Marks of Ascension per quest.

This means the maximum cost for the Hand of Fates (2000 Marks of Ascension) is now met at your 70th quest while previously this maximum cost was obtained once reaching your 35th Hand of Fate quest.
